title: AlcaTRAz - Anchored Tree-Rule Defense Against Jailbreaks
abstract: arXiv:2609.03693v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that bypass safety alignment through carefully crafted prompts. Many existing defenses require access to model weights or internals, making them difficult to apply to black-box deployments. We propose AlcaTRAz (Anchored Tree-Rule defense Against jailbreaks), a prompt-level defense based on rule trees that operates exclusively on the input text and requires no modification or retraining of the target model. The method automatically learns a transferable transformation rule that inserts controlled character-level perturbations at selected positions, thereby disrupting structural regularities exploited by jailbreak attacks while largely preserving the model's utility on benign queries. translated_title: AlcaTRAz——基于锚定树规则的越狱攻击防御
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）容易受到越狱攻击的影响，攻击者通过精心构造的提示绕过模型的安全对齐机制。许多现有的防御方法需要访问模型权重或内部结构，这使其难以应用于黑盒部署场景。我们提出了AlcaTRAz（基于锚定树规则的越狱攻击防御），这是一种基于规则树的提示级防御方法，仅作用于输入文本，无需对目标模型进行修改或重新训练。该方法自动学习一种可迁移的变换规则，在选定位置插入受控的字符级扰动，从而破坏越狱攻击所利用的结构规律性，同时在很大程度上保持模型对良性查询的实用性。我们在33个开源权重模型、22种越狱攻击类型以及一个由简短单轮良性问题构成的基准上评估了所提出的方法，并与三种代表性的提示级防御方法进行了比较。
tldr: 提出AlcaTRAz，一种仅作用于输入文本、无需修改或重训目标模型的提示级越狱防御方法，通过自动学习可迁移的字符级扰动规则树破坏越狱攻击的结构规律，同时保持模型对良性查询的实用性。
en_tdlr: AlcaTRAz is a prompt-level defense against LLM jailbreaks that operates solely on input text—requiring no model modification or retraining—by automatically learning transferable character-level perturbation rules that disrupt attack structural patterns while preserving model utility.
